name: matricula-aberta-monorepo
description: Monorepo Monolito Modular — Matrícula Aberta (Rede Municipal de Ensino de Patos - PB)

scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/server run typecheck && packages/web/node_modules/.bin/tsc --project packages/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm --prefix packages/web run build && rm -rf ./dist && cp -r packages/web/dist ./dist
